stemMd: Why could smaller predictable donations improve the result?

options.label: A
options.textMd: They could fit the group’s handling capacity and reduce spoilage.

options.label: B
options.textMd: They guaranteed that households would never waste food.

options.label: C
options.textMd: They increased the number collected by definition.

options.label: D
options.textMd: They made every kilogram intrinsically more nutritious.

options.label: E
options.textMd: They eliminated all need for vehicles.

explanationMd: Predictability and manageable volume can allow timely storage and distribution. The text reports more edible food reaching households despite less being collected. This supports better coordination rather than an increase in the food’s inherent nutritional value.

distractorRationale.b: The group’s control ends before that universal claim.
distractorRationale.e: Transport remained part of the operation.
